home_title: Claimball: win the notebook, one tile at a time
home_desc: Claimball is a casual duel game for iOS and Android, coming soon. Bounce the ball on a notebook grid, turn tiles into your land, and beat AI rivals in quick matches of about 90 seconds.
hero_h1: Win the notebook, |one tile at a time.
hero_lead: A casual duel against an AI rival on a notebook grid. The tile where your ball bounces becomes your land. Miss, and you lose land.
hero_note: Free to try. One purchase unlocks everything. No ads, no subscription.
board_aria: Illustration of a Claimball match on a 6 by 10 notebook grid, with blue and orange tiles claimed by the two sides
card1_p: The board is a 6 by 10 notebook grid. The tile where the ball bounces becomes the land of the player who hit it. A miss loses land.
card2_p: Catch the ball with the center of your paddle for a smash. A smash claims 3 tiles at once.
card3_p: A match takes about 90 seconds. The final seconds are a showdown.
rivals_p: Every match is you against an AI rival. There are 6 AI rivals across 2 leagues at launch, with more planned in updates.
